model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the loss values over a range of iterations for different models. The x-axis, labeled "#Iteration", is on a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 140,000 with tick labels at regular intervals of 20,000. The y-axis, labeled "Loss", is also on a linear scale, ranging from 2.4 to 3.4 with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. There are six lines in the plot, each representing a different model: Vanilla (purple, solid), StrmLLM (n=64) (blue, solid), SepLLM (n=64) (orange, solid), SepLLM (n=64, H) (green, solid), SepLLM (n=64, H/T) (red, solid), and SepLLM (n=128) (dark blue, solid). All lines start at a loss value slightly below 3.4 and decrease steadily to a value slightly above 2.5 over the course of 140,000 iterations, with the lines for SepLLM (n=64, H/T) and SepLLM (n=128) appearing to converge at the end of the x-axis.
